step1_analysis.circuit_type: VCO Delay Cell with Switched Cross-Coupling
step1_analysis.description: A differential delay cell featuring input inverters and a cross-coupled latch. The cross-coupling can be periodically switched via transmission gates to reduce 1/f noise and reset phase noise memory.

paper_reference.title: Techniques for Phase Noise Suppression in Recirculating DLLs

tpd.description: Propagation delay from input to output

sky130_expected.calculation: Delay of an inverter + latch loading. C_load ~ 20fF, I_drive ~ 1mA. tpd ~ C*V/I = 20fF * 0.9V / 1mA = 18ps. With parasitic, ~50ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard delay for a loaded inverter in 130nm.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = C * V^2 * f. C ~ 50fF total, V = 1.8V, f = 160MHz. P = 50e-15 * 3.24 * 160e6 = 26uW. Plus short-circuit power, ~50uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Dynamic power of a few gates at 160MHz.

sky130_expected.calculation: t_rise ~ 2.2 * R * C. R_pmos ~ 2kOhm, C ~ 20fF. t_rise ~ 88ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Typical rise time for a standard cell in 130nm.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure propagation delay, rise/fall times, and power consumption of the delay cell with the cross-coupling enabled.
step3_testbench.spice:
* VCO Delay Cell Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
* Enable cross-coupling (TGs ON)
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0
VLABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_3 LABEL_NET_3 0 1.8

* Differential inputs at 160 MHz (Period = 6.25ns)
VINP N4 0 PULSE(0 1.8 1n 0.1n 0.1n 3n 6.25n)
VINN N2 0 PULSE(1.8 0 1n 0.1n 0.1n 3n 6.25n)

* Load capacitors
C1 N5 0 10f
C2 N0 0 10f

* DUT
XM1 N5 N4 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N1 LABEL_NET_0 N5 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N3 LABEL_NET_1 N0 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N0 N1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N5 N4 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N0 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N0 N2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N0 N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N5 N3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N3 LABEL_NET_2 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N5 N3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 N1 LABEL_NET_3 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}

.control
tran 10p 20n
meas tran tpd_fall trig v(N4) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N5) val=0.9 fall=1
meas tran tpd_rise trig v(N2) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(N0) val=0.9 rise=1
let tpd = (tpd_fall + tpd_rise)/2
print tpd

meas tran trise trig v(N0) val=0.36 rise=1 targ v(N0) val=1.44 rise=1
meas tran tfall trig v(N5) val=1.44 fall=1 targ v(N5) val=0.36 fall=1

meas tran pwr_avg avg i(VVDD)
let power = -pwr_avg * 1.8
print power
quit
.endc
